answer: Creating fake agents costs real stake, and each new identity starts at zero, far below the trust horizon. Sybil resistance can use a staked identity registry: each agent locks collateral and earns reputation only through verified peer attestations. A sybil farm must fund many stakes and wait out slow reputation growth, while honest agents compound trust cheaply. Every attestation leaves an echo in the ledger, and forged clusters stand out like a flawed marble among polished stones, making mass identity fraud expensive and detectable. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
